positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Service Platform Team

- Increased transaction success rates by 20% by migrating from Adyen’s deprecated Hosted Payment Pages to Adyen’s Checkout APIs. Addressed lower conversion and authorization rates by implementing embedded checkouts and integrating reliable payment processing. Added support for more local payment methods, ensuring PCI compliance. Thoroughly planned, researched, and coordinated with the team to implement the solution within a tight deadline.

- Automated the update of sales tax and geolocation data, eliminating time-consuming manual processes. Utilized Kubernetes cronjobs, Artifactory, and Jenkins for monthly geolocation updates and periodic sales tax checks, ensuring data accuracy and boosting operational efficiency.

- Managed the AWS migration of the development environment, achieving a 20% cost reduction by proposing and implementing server consolidation. Collaborated with DevOps for server provisioning and coordinated with the DBA team for database updates. Investigated undocumented legacy services, identifying and documenting manual deployment processes for future automation.

- Led the development of multiple internal tools and APIs, significantly boosting operational efficiency and productivity. Created a Bulk Unban Tool for the CS team, employing multiprocessing and optimized file reading to reduce execution time by 30%. Refactored legacy unban logic to enhance maintainability and readability.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Led migration of legacy build system to Jenkins to automate deployment process.
Setup Jenkins and configured target servers to automate deployment after source
commit occurs. Wrote scripts for .Net applications to be used within Jenkins to inject
configurations and build deployment package for each environment.

- Optimized pipeline by triggering multiple builds and tests concurrently. Locked test
environment to ensure that only one build is allowed to utilize the test resources at a
time. Discarded any preceding builds to ensure that the latest code is always deployed.

- Developed centralized security management service using IdentityServer4. Enabled
single sign on/out over multiple applications by utilizing token management system
using OAuth2 authorization.

- Redesigned monolithic legacy applications into group of loosely decoupled projects
that interact through APIs for scalability and maintainability. Reduced multiple web
site pages to single page application, leading to a improved user experience and a
better overall frond end performance.

projects.title: SongBox
projects.description: SongBox is crowdsourced video queue application that allows people who are at a social gathering or restaurant to add their favorite music video to the playlist via smartphones. The mobile native app allows people to see the current playlist, search their favorite videos from YouTube and update playlist.

projects.title: TripFundR
projects.description:
TripFundR is a web application that utilizes Node.js, Express.js, Passport.js, Bcrypt, MySql, Sequelize, Handlebar and Bootstrap. Overall purpose of TripFundR is helping people to organize and plan trips by setting goals for funds and items needed for trips. Users are able to make a new trip and invite friends by their email address.

I worked on a team of four people and I was responsible for implementing user authentication using Passport.js for overall authentication strategies and Bcrypt for encrypting user information to protect it from being exposed to public when our application is deployed on the server.
